args.stdin:
WITH product AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  INNER JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp1.property_key)) = 'wattage' AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp1.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM('15 W'))
  INNER JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp2.property_key)) = 'luminous flux' AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp2.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM('1055 lm'))
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pv.brand)) = LOWER(TRIM('Osram'))
    AND LOWER(TRIM(pv.series)) = LOWER(TRIM('Eco Classic 3PW-R88'))
    AND LOWER(TRIM(pv.model)) = LOWER(TRIM('LED Bulb'))
)
SELECT p.product_sku, p.record_path, COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity), 0) AS total_available
FROM product p
CROSS JOIN (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE LOWER(TRIM(city)) = LOWER(TRIM('Vienna'))) s
LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON s.store_id = si.store_id AND si.product_sku = p.product_sku
GROUP BY p.product_sku, p.record_path;
SELECT record_path FROM stores WHERE LOWER(TRIM(city)) = LOWER(TRIM('Vienna'));
